verdictEs: Fextralife si necesitas cobertura completa con community comments y aceptas ads agresivas; Game8 si valoras UI guide-style limpia y recommendations directas.
verdictEn: Fextralife if you need complete coverage with community comments and accept aggressive ads; Game8 if you value clean guide-style UI and direct recommendations.

useCases.reasonEs: Fextralife tiene comments por página con tips no documentados. Game8 es strictly factual sin sección de comments.
useCases.reasonEn: Fextralife has per-page comments with undocumented tips. Game8 is strictly factual with no comments section.

useCases.reasonEs: Game8 formatea como priority order (do A, then B, then C). Fextralife tiene la info pero en formato wiki menos prescriptivo.
useCases.reasonEn: Game8 formats as priority order (do A, then B, then C). Fextralife has the info but in less prescriptive wiki format.

useCases.reasonEs: Game8 tiene tablas y charts dedicados por Nightlord. Fextralife usa prose más extenso, menos scaneable.
useCases.reasonEn: Game8 has dedicated per-Nightlord tables and charts. Fextralife uses longer prose, less scannable.

useCases.labelEs: Cobertura exhaustiva de relics y weapons
useCases.reasonEs: Cada item tiene página individual en Fextralife. Game8 agrupa por priority, no por item.
useCases.reasonEn: Every item has an individual page on Fextralife. Game8 groups by priority, not per item.

useCases.reasonEs: Game8 tiene UX cleaner en mobile con menos ads. Fextralife mobile es difícil de leer por ad density.
useCases.reasonEn: Game8 has cleaner mobile UX with fewer ads. Fextralife mobile is hard to read due to ad density.
